illustration.alt: Audrey standing beside a kind unicorn in a magical forest.

paragraphs: There once lived a curious girl named Audrey who loved thinking about new and exciting things.
One day, she was walking down a street near her house when a mysterious glowing gem suddenly caught her attention.
Curious about where it had come from, Audrey carefully picked it up.
At first, everything seemed very fine until Audrey suddenly touched the glowing gem and fell asleep in the middle of the street.
Everything went dark, and when she opened her eyes again, she realized that she was lying in the middle of a strange forest.
A sign nearby read, “Paint Family,” and a herd of colorful unicorns appeared before her eyes.
As Audrey looked around in amazement, she noticed a small unicorn that was about to burst into tears because its leg was hurt.
“Please save my life! I will do anything to help you when you are in danger,” the unicorn murmured.
Even though Audrey wanted to keep exploring, she carefully tied its injured leg with a bandage.
The unicorn happily galloped away, and Audrey wondered if she would ever meet it again.
But then, the biggest problem appeared when Audrey wandered deeper into the forest and suddenly found herself surrounded by a group of huge, evil unicorns.
They emerged from behind the trees one by one, blocking every possible escape route.
Their angry eyes glowed as they slowly moved closer to her.
Audrey's heart began to pound, and a cold shiver ran down her spine.
She tried to escape through a narrow space between two of them, but another unicorn quickly blocked her way.
Even though Audrey tried to stay brave, she realized that she was completely trapped.
Helplessly sitting on the ground, she knew she had to think quickly before the monsters attacked.
However, luckily, something amazing happened just when Audrey was about to lose hope.
Suddenly, the unicorn she had helped earlier appeared on a hill and let out a powerful cry.
Audrey's eyes widened as she realized that it had come back to keep its promise.
Its horn began to glow, sending sparkling waves of magic across the forest.
One by one, the evil unicorns became frightened and disappeared into the darkness.
The kind unicorn quickly lowered its back so Audrey could climb on.
They galloped through the forest until they finally reached the place where Audrey had first arrived.
When Audrey climbed off its back, she thanked the unicorn for saving her.
At that moment, she understood that the kindness she had shown earlier had returned to her when she needed it most.
In the end, Audrey pushed open a mysterious door and dashed inside.
When the elevator doors opened, she suddenly found herself safely back home.
From that day on, Audrey never forgot that even a small act of kindness could come back in an unexpected way.

praise: You gave Audrey a clear adventure with a beginning, a problem, a rescue, and a meaningful ending.
Audrey's kindness returning when she needed help makes the message easy to remember.
praiseKo: Audrey의 모험이 시작, 문제, 구출, 의미 있는 결말로 분명하게 이어지도록 잘 구성했어요.
Audrey가 베푼 친절이 도움이 되어 돌아오는 장면 덕분에 이야기의 메시지가 오래 기억돼요.
authorStudio.tryNext: On your next page, add one sentence that shows what Audrey feels when she sees the magical world again.
authorStudio.tryNextKo: 다음 페이지에서는 Audrey가 마법의 세계를 다시 보았을 때 어떤 기분이 들었는지 한 문장으로 보여 주세요.

choices.prompt: The glowing gem appears in Audrey's room. Write 3–5 sentences about what happens next.
choices.promptKo: 빛나는 보석이 Audrey의 방에 나타났어요. 다음에 어떤 일이 생기는지 3~5문장으로 써 보세요.

choices.prompt: The kind unicorn visits Audrey's world with an important message. Write 3–5 sentences about the visit.

title: The Most Special Day I Have Ever Had

illustration.alt: Two best friends completing adventure missions together.

paragraphs: Have you ever had a surprising and unforgettable day?
To me, the most extraordinary day was when I went to KidZania with my best friend.
There are three reasons why this day holds a special place in my heart: I spent the whole day with my friend, had a surprising sleepover, and completed exciting adventure missions.
To begin with, the day was special because my best friend was with me.
Since I did not know my way around KidZania very well, my friend led the way and introduced me to different activities.
We ran from place to place, laughed together, and decided which activities we wanted to try next.
Whenever I felt unsure about something, my friend encouraged me to give it a try.
Looking back, I still feel thankful that I had a friend beside me because every activity became much more exciting when we experienced it together.
Furthermore, to my surprise, my mom allowed me to have a sleepover with my friend after our long day at KidZania.
I had not expected it at all, so I could hardly believe what was happening.
Even though we were tired, we talked about our favorite moments from the day and laughed about the funny things that had happened.
We even discussed which activities we wanted to try the next time we visited.
The more I think about it, the more grateful I feel because the unexpected sleepover made an already wonderful day even more special.
Most importantly, the best part of the day was completing the adventure missions at KidZania.
A helper gave us a mission pack filled with different challenges.
For the first mission, I had to carefully cross a rope course without falling.
Another challenge was jumping from a high place twenty times within one hundred seconds, and one mission sent us searching for a hidden gem.
My heart was pounding with excitement as my friend and I rushed from one challenge to another.
Some missions were difficult, but finishing them made me feel brave and proud.
It felt like a dream come true to spend an entire day going on exciting adventures with my friend.
In conclusion, my trip to KidZania was one of the most special days of my life because I spent time with my best friend, enjoyed a surprising sleepover, and completed unforgettable missions.
It was one of the happiest moments of my life.
If I could relive one day, it would definitely be that day.

praise: You organized the memory clearly around three reasons, so the reader can follow the whole day.
Details such as the rope course, the timed jumps, and the hidden gem make the adventure feel real.
praiseKo: 세 가지 이유를 중심으로 추억을 분명하게 정리해서 독자가 하루의 이야기를 쉽게 따라갈 수 있어요.
로프 코스, 시간 안에 뛰기, 숨은 보석 찾기 같은 구체적인 내용이 모험을 생생하게 만들어요.
authorStudio.tryNext: Choose one favorite mission and add a sound, a feeling, or one line of dialogue to bring that moment even closer.
authorStudio.tryNextKo: 가장 좋아했던 미션 하나를 골라 소리, 느낌 또는 짧은 대화를 한 문장 더하면 그 순간이 더욱 생생해져요.
